About Us

A Somerset Wrap Shop That Sweats the Detail

We're Ace Wraps Customs, based at Drakes Business Centre in Creech Heathfield, just outside Taunton. Wraps are what we do all day, every day, and it shows in the finish: edges tucked, panels stripped where they need to be, and no bubbles or lifting corners six months down the road.

Every job is quoted upfront before we touch the car. No hidden extras, no surprises when you collect the keys.

Common Questions

FAQ

No. On healthy factory paint a quality wrap actually protects the panels underneath, and it removes cleanly when you want a change. If your paint is already damaged or resprayed, we'll tell you before we start.
It depends on the vehicle and how complex the job is, but most full wraps take a few days in the unit. We'll give you an accurate timeframe when we quote.
With decent care, quality vinyl lasts for years. How it's washed, where it's parked and how many miles it does all play a part, and we'll talk you through looking after it at handover.
Yes, and it's one of the most common reasons people wrap. The vinyl comes off cleanly at the end of the agreement, so the car goes back in its original colour.
Hand washing is best. Avoid harsh chemicals and don't hold a pressure washer right up against edges. We'll give you the full rundown when you collect the car.
No. We do roofs, bonnets, accents and partial wraps too, alongside window tinting and paint protection film. If you're not sure what you want, come and have a chat.
